bodyHtml:
Rascals 2 - 0 Spindles

In the season's first Thursday night matchup, Spindles forgot to show up and were held scoreless against Rascals.

Two first-half goals and a dominant attacking threat left the Spins in the dust for the first 45'.

After a brief intermission, Spindles came out in the second half with much higher energy.

Moving the ball around, pressing the defense, and stopping attacks.

However, it was not enough as they struggled to complete a handful of chances.

Despite another great turnout of supporters, the Spins fell short with a final score of 2-0 Rascals.

This is now Spindles second straight loss, with 0 goals from open play across 180 minutes.

The players will have another week to flip the switch and look for all 3 points against Deathwish on Thursday, May 30 at 6:15 pm.
